title: Scripta Story Design
summary: Designs or revises a book's thematic question, reader promise, flexible arcs, characters, relationships and world assumptions before drafting, then validates the design.v1 brief with a dependency-free Node.js validator.
outputs: A story-design brief JSON (schema design.v1) written as proposal/story-design.json in an external assessment workspace, with thematic question, reader promise, arcs, characters, relationships and world assumptions
One JSON validation result on stdout with schema_version, ok, errors and warnings (validate-design.mjs)
